name: v1.8.9
body: Optimize incremental-sync pagination by selecting indexed page keys before fetching payloads, while retaining prepared statement reuse. Includes staged production autoscaling configuration and deployment guardrails. See #1840 for validation and rollout details.

name: v1.8.8
body:
This release uses the source commit validated in staging. Different server names may now share a remote URL; consumers should key listings by server name and version rather than assuming URL uniqueness. No database migration is required.

* Stage v1.8.7 in production with prepared reads disabled by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1769
* Enable prepared listing JSON after production backfill by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1770
* Prepare bounded app autoscaling with worker headroom by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1772
* Add sanitized apply diagnostics and a guarded retry path by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1774
* Filter deployment diagnostics to actual error events by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1775
* fix(deploy): preserve saved-plan checks across targeted dependency metadata by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1776
* fix(deploy): use explicit CRD dependencies for backup chart by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1777
* feat(deploy): activate bounded production app autoscaling by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1779
* Reduce idle staging capacity with guarded autoscaling minimums by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1781
* Handle removed chart budgets in staging capacity updates by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1782
* build(deps): bump the go-dependencies group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1761
* build(deps): bump docker/login-action from 4.6.0 to 4.7.0 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1762
* build(deps): bump github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4 from 4.1.4 to 4.1.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1763
* build(deps): bump github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4 from 4.1.4 to 4.1.6 in /deploy by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1764
* build(deps): bump the deploy-go-dependencies group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1773
* Bound ingress scaling with matching worker headroom by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1790
* Restore ingress reservation while retaining scaling headroom by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1791
* Increase production burst ceilings without changing baseline capacity by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1793
* Prepare smaller always-on staging and guarded node rightsizing by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1794
* Resize prepared staging to two e2-standard-2 nodes by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1795
* Compress public listing JSON and sample successful access logs in staging by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1798
* Enable public listing compression and selective log retention in production by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1799
* docs: clarify production preview access by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1800
* fix(infra): qualify patched controllers and Grafana in staging by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1801
* fix(infra): exclude completed admission hooks from saved-plan upgrades by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1802
* fix(infra): constrain the new CRD reference in saved plans by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1804
* fix(infra): promote security patches to production by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1803
* Allow remote URLs to be shared across server names by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1806
* build(deps): bump github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3 from 3.272.0 to 3.273.0 in /deploy in the deploy-go-dependencies group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1796
* Restore normal staging and production release flow by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1809
* Refresh state before applying saved deployment plans by @rdimitrov in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/pull/1810


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry/compare/v1.8.7...v1.8.8

name: v1.8.7
body:
Adds prepared listing JSON to avoid repeated decoding and rebuilding of server payloads on listing reads. Prepared reads are disabled by default and support bounded backfill and flag rollback. Listing rows release their database connection before JSON processing; pool defaults remain 60/10.

Focused response/update/delete/backfill/rollback checks passed. Local encoding benchmarks over saved public records measured 63% less encoding time and 88% fewer allocations. These are encoding-cost results, not a peak-capacity guarantee. Broad staging replay remained inconclusive for capacity due to generator port exhaustion and losses.

name: v1.8.6
body:
This release improves registry search performance under mixed search, pagination and publishing traffic.

- Select search page keys through covering indexes before fetching complete records.
- Plan searches for their actual parameter values to handle broad and rare terms reliably.
- Optimize namespace suffix searches and require at least three Unicode characters for nonempty search terms (shorter searches return HTTP 422).
- Include reproducible cyclic-load benchmarks and repeated staging validation against a public production-data snapshot.

Deployment: prebuild and verify migrations 016/017 indexes concurrently on busy databases. The validated burst capacity uses a 3-CPU PostgreSQL quota on the existing nodes, with the application connection pool unchanged. See deploy/README.md and tools/readbench/STAGING_SEARCH_RESULTS.md for procedure, evidence and limitations.
